# Moodle Design System

> React components and design tokens for Moodle. Package: @moodlehq/design-system@5.4.0.

Read the per-component guidance before choosing a component. Props come from the TypeScript types in `dist/`.

## Guidance

- [Index](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@moodlehq/design-system@5.4.0/dist/guidance/index.md): one line per page with status
- [Breadcrumb](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@moodlehq/design-system@5.4.0/dist/guidance/components/breadcrumb.md)
